errors.text_span: Третата категория, означена с зелен цвят, е „Под 1 година“ и заема 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the green slice represents "Под 1 година" (Under 1 year). According to the legend, the green slice represents "От 16 до 30 години" (From 16 to 30 years), and its value is indeed 13.6%.

errors.text_span: Четвъртата категория, означена с лилав цвят, е „От 16 до 30 години“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the purple slice represents "От 16 до 30 години" (From 16 to 30 years). According to the legend, the purple slice represents "Над 30 години" (Over 30 years).
The chart does not provide a percentage value for the purple slice. The value 5.6% is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: Петата категория, означена с тъмно лилав цвят, е „Над 30 години“ и заема около 3,8%.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly re-describes the purple slice with a different hallucinated percentage. The value 3.8% is not present in the chart.

errors.text_span: Шестата категория, означена с син цвят, е „Не сме организирали обучение по лидерство“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the blue color to the category "Не сме организирали обучение по лидерство" (We have not organized leadership training). The legend shows that the blue slice represents "Под 1 година" (Under 1 year), and the teal slice represents "Не сме организирали обучение по лидерство".
The chart does not provide a percentage value for the blue slice (or the teal slice). The value 4.2% is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: като всеки сектор има изрично отбелязан процентен дял
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that every sector has an explicit percentage label. In the figure, only three out of the six sectors have percentage labels.

errors.text_span: секторите са разположени по часовниковата стрелка във визуално нарастващ ред спрямо размера
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged clockwise in increasing order of size. This is incorrect. The order of percentages starting from the top and going clockwise is 13.6%, a small percentage, another small percentage, another small percentage, 36.4%, and 36.4%. This is not an increasing order.
